sources.title: GitHub - pjlab-sys4nlp/llama-moe: ⛷️ LLaMA-MoE: Building Mixture-of ...
sources.snippet: LLaMA-MoE is a series of open-sourced Mixture-of-Expert (MoE) models based on LLaMA and SlimPajama. We build LLaMA-MoE with the following two steps: Partition LLaMA's FFNs into sparse experts and insert top-K gate for each layer of experts. Continually pre-train the initialized MoE model with an optimized data sampling weights from Sheared LLaMA and filtered datasets from SlimPajama.
